scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e && npm --prefix frontend test
